basic_info.description: We are honoured to be recognised as one of the Top 10 Best Places to Work in the UK for the third year running, according to Glassdoor’s prestigious 2026 list.Equal Experts is a global technology consultancy built on experience. With over 4,000 skilled and trusted consultants, our network is the highest concentration of digital technology expertise in the world. We combine speed, precision and pragmatism to solve complex challenges, deliver lasting value and turn ambition into reality.Since 2007, we have collaborated with forward-looking businesses across sectors, from scale-ups to government organisations and global enterprises, to solve complex challenges and deliver lasting value.Bringing deep experienceOur customers benefit from smaller, senior teams with an average of 17+ years in the industry. This depth of experience helps us reduce risk, accelerate decision-making and build practical solutions.Keeping you innovatingWith expertise across data, AI, technology strategy, customer experience, product design, software engineering and platform modernisation, our trusted network of specialists help you navigate complexity and accelerate pragmatic innovation.Easy to work withValuing context, we never offer cookie-cutter solutions. Treating each other and our customers as equals, we work side by side to create long-lasting value.A 100% network-owned organisationWe believe that to be successful for the long term, we need to succeed together. As associates, employees and customers, we all have a vested interest in making Equal Experts the best it can possibly be.If you are looking for a thoughtful and experienced partner to solve complex challenges and unlock new opportunities, we would love to talk.
